title: Performance
subtitle: Review cycles, goals, reviews, competencies and development plans across the organization.
teamSubtitle: Goals, reviews and development plans of your team.
ownSubtitle: Your reviews, goals and development plans.
demoDataNote: Demo data — fictional reviews. The rating scale and competencies are configurable examples, not a performance policy.

cycleStatusHints.draft: The cycle goes back to draft.
cycleStatusHints.active: Creates a review for every participant. Dates and the template can no longer be changed.
cycleStatusHints.in-progress: Set automatically on the first submission.
cycleStatusHints.completed: Set automatically when every manager review is submitted.
cycleStatusHints.closed: Closing is final: reviews can no longer be written. Their history stays available.

kpis.label: Performance key figures
kpis.activeCyclesHint: Cycles that are active or in progress.
kpis.pendingSelfHint: Self-assessments not yet submitted in active cycles.
kpis.pendingManagerHint: Submitted self-assessments still awaiting the manager review.
kpis.completedHint: Reviews with a submitted manager review in active cycles.
kpis.averageRatingHint: Average overall rating of completed reviews in active cycles.

cycles.title: Review cycles
cycles.periodHint: The period whose performance is reviewed. Periods of cycles may not overlap.
cycles.created: Review cycle "{{name}}" created as a draft.
cycles.draftParticipants: Participants assigned: {{value}}. Their reviews are created when the cycle is activated.
cycles.assignDraftHint: Reviews are created when the cycle is activated.
cycles.assignOpenHint: The cycle is open: a review is created for each new participant now.
cycles.notFound: This review cycle does not exist.

goals.title: Goals
goals.targetHint: Make it measurable, e.g. "Answer 90% of requests within 4 hours".
goals.cycleHint: Goals in a cycle are rated in that cycle's review.
goals.finalNote: Completed and cancelled goals can no longer be updated.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.selfHint: Rate how far you achieved each goal and describe your achievements. After submitting you can no longer edit it unless HR reopens it.
reviews.managerHint: Rate goal achievement and competencies on the configured scale, then give an overall rating. The employee sees the review once you submit it.
reviews.selfNotSubmitted: The self-assessment has not been submitted yet.
reviews.managerNotSubmitted: The manager review has not been submitted yet.
reviews.managerDraft: The manager review is being written (draft).
reviews.waitForSelf: The manager review opens once the self-assessment is submitted or its deadline has passed.
reviews.reopenSelfText: The employee can edit and submit it again. A submitted manager review is reopened as a draft too.
reviews.reopenManagerText: The reviewer can edit and submit it again.

plans.title: Development plans
plans.activitiesHint: Update the status of each activity as it progresses.
plans.notFound: This development plan does not exist.

competencies.title: Competencies
competencies.codeHint: Unique, e.g. COMM. Letters, digits and hyphens.
competencies.criteriaHint: What each rating means for this competency (example guidance).
competencies.confirmDeactivateText: It can no longer be added to templates. Reviews already created keep it.

templates.title: Review templates
templates.lockedHint: Templates used by an open cycle cannot be changed (its reviews were created from them).

scale.title: Rating scale
scale.subtitle: Configurable example labels — not a performance policy.
scale.hint: The values 1–5 are fixed; their labels and descriptions can be changed.

history.selfDue: Your self-assessment for "{{cycle}}" is waiting for you.
history.forbidden: This employee's performance is outside your access.

details.forbidden: This record is outside your access.

validation.endBeforeStart: The end must be on or after the start.
validation.deadlineOutsideCycle: The deadline must fall within the cycle dates.
validation.managerBeforeSelf: The manager review deadline must be on or after the self-assessment deadline.
validation.dueBeforeStart: The due date must be on or after the start date.
validation.codeFormat: Use capital letters, digits and single hyphens.
validation.activityAfterPlan: The activity must be due on or before the plan's target date.

serverErrors.scaleValuesFixed: The scale values cannot change; only their labels can.
serverErrors.competencyInUse: This competency is used by an open review cycle.
serverErrors.duplicateCode: Another competency already uses this code.
serverErrors.inactiveCompetency: Only active competencies can be added.
serverErrors.templateInUse: This template is used by an open review cycle.
serverErrors.periodOverlap: This review period overlaps another cycle.
serverErrors.noParticipants: Assign at least one employee before activating.
serverErrors.reviewStarted: This employee has already started their review.
serverErrors.cycleClosed: This cycle no longer accepts goals.
serverErrors.completedNeeds100: A completed goal must be at 100%.
serverErrors.startedHasProgress: A goal with progress cannot be "Not started".
serverErrors.goalsChanged: The goals of this review changed. Reload the page.
serverErrors.competenciesChanged: The competencies of this review changed. Reload the page.
serverErrors.ratingScale: The rating is not on the configured scale.
serverErrors.selfPending: Wait for the self-assessment (or its deadline) before submitting the manager review.
serverErrors.invalidStatus: This status is not allowed here.
serverErrors.activitiesOpen: Mark every activity as done before completing the plan.
serverErrors.employeeLocked: The employee of a plan cannot change.
serverErrors.stateChanged: This record changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
